title: PAL invoice-upload utility class: local and group currency validated independently in the AR and GL upload
sap_objects: ZCL_INV_UTILITY (class; methods validate_inv_data_ar and validate_inv_data_gl changed)
ZFM_INV_DOC_CHECK (function module, RFC NONE; called, not changed)
BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST (BAPI; called from process_invoice_data, not changed)
module: FI (AP supplier / AR customer / GL journal invoice upload behind custom Fiori tiles); the folder does not name the module explicitly
end_client_evidence: NOTES.md title: 'ZCL_INV_UTILITY — NOTES (PAL, company code PR01)'; NOTES.md: 'Utility class behind the PAL invoice-upload Fiori tiles (AP supplier, AR customer, GL journal).' No system ID, ticket or person is named in this folder.
business_requirement: In the AR and GL upload, a document whose local (or group) currency amounts do not balance was accepted with no validation error as long as the document currency balanced. The upload must reject such documents with a message that names the currency that is out of balance.
technical_challenge: In validate_inv_data_ar and validate_inv_data_gl the local and group checks sat inside one IF that required both currency codes to be filled, so one blank code skipped every check. The four totals were inline DATA(...) declarations inside that branch and were never cleared, so a skipped document was compared against the previous document's totals; one combined IF produced one message for all three currencies. The class is 5,367 lines.
ai_contribution: From the class source pasted into the session on 12/10/26, the assistant named the root cause (skipped checks plus stale totals) and wrote the whole corrected class (5,367 -> 5,758 lines) with 6 BOC/EOC blocks dated 12/10/26. Both methods now declare the totals explicitly and clear them per document, validate local and group in separate blocks, treat an amount without a currency code as an error, and issue three currency-specific balance messages. NOTES.md records seven gotchas, including pre-existing defects that were deliberately left untouched (RETURN-TYPE 'W' mapped twice, the 0.07 fix written to the wrong field in transform_inv_data_ar, hardcoded PHP/USD, no rate check, AP flow not validating local/group).
manual_intervention: Arnav pasted the class source into the session (NOTES.md: 'as pasted into the session 12/10/26 (5367 lines)'). His test is still outstanding (ISSUES.md: 'Corrected, awaiting Arnav's test'). Pasting the two method bodies or the whole class in SE24 / ADT is a manual step (NOTES.md, 'Shipping: PASTE').
status_evidence: ISSUES.md row 1, Status column: 'Corrected, awaiting Arnav's test'; TR column: '—'. No entry records a paste, an activation or a test result.

end_client_evidence: ISSUES.md: 'PAL (Philippine Airlines) | FI-AR | Systems DS4 → QS4 → PS4.'; 'Ticket: INC01967 | Reporter: Czarmagne Ashly Retis (AR) on behalf of Cebu Air, Inc. / Cebu Pacific Air (Jazieline Kaye B. Caoile).'; 'SU53 evidence, QS4, 13/10/26 (user 408723, transaction `ZFIBSDMCM`)'. NOTES.md: 'Author DAGOYAOY (2022); later hands PPUNO, ARAO. Package ZABAP.' original/ZFI03CUSTINV1.TXT header: 'Transport No.: DS4K900249' (the original program's transport, not this fix).
wricef_or_ticket: INC01967 (earlier changes in the same FORM by others: INC01036, INC01368)
business_requirement: Invoice PDFs e-mailed to customers by the program (radio button rb_email) could not be opened in Acrobat or Edge, while the same document saved with Save as PDF, or resent manually by AR, opened. Customers must receive a readable invoice PDF and the e-mail log must not report success for a broken mail.
technical_challenge: The mail path does not attach the Adobe output: it writes the PDF to the application server, runs an external OS command, waits 2 seconds, reads the file back and attaches the read-back, with no return code checked anywhere in the chain. The failure depended on the executing user's S_DATASET authorisation, so it did not reproduce under a developer user, and production could not be changed from Arnav's ID; the cause had to be proven from debugger values, role comparison, SUSR_USER_AUTH_FOR_OBJ_GET and SU53.
ai_contribution: From a 7,084-line SE80 print listing the assistant rebuilt one source file per include with a new parser (scripts/unlist.py), traced the mail path and identified the unchecked write / encrypt / read-back round trip as the only path that can corrupt the attachment. It delivered the whole corrected include ZFI_03_CUSTINV_FORM (5,020 -> 5,197 lines, 20 BOC/EOC blocks dated 10/10/26): every step checked, read-back validated (%PDF header, %%EOF, /Encrypt, exact size), nothing sent and the log set to Failed on any error, plus a switch lc_encrypt (default off) that attaches the in-memory PDF. It wrote a check list that needs no development access (SOST, SM69, AL11, SM37, ST22) and a production debugging recipe that ends before the send. From the evidence Arnav brought back it narrowed the cause to a missing S_DATASET authorisation of the sending user and named the narrow authorisation set for Security.
manual_intervention: Arnav supplied the SE80 print listing (10.10.26); debugged in production on 12/10/26 under his own user (credit memo AVIAREPS KFT., stopped at o_send_request->send and ended with /n, nothing sent) and reported the variable values; relayed AR's report that the mail works from one user ID and not from another; supplied SUIM role lists for the working and three failing users, the SUSR_USER_AUTH_FOR_OBJ_GET output and the SU53 from QS4; took the decision on 13/10/26 to have Security assign ZFI_AR_COLLECTIONS_PAL / _PALEX and retest with one document. Security assigned the role. Transport of the corrected include is manual and still pending.

title: PAL Ariba Sourcing to S/4 purchase orders: no PO for materials with a rounding value; BAdI ME_BAPI_PO_CUST sets NO_ROUNDING (INC01192)
end_client_evidence: ISSUES.md: 'PAL (Philippine Airlines) — Ariba Sourcing → S4 PO | MM'; 'Ticket: INC01192 (repeat of INC00512) | Functional: Mahender Reddy Patlolla | Business: Zheryn Kaye A. Broqueza, Jo Valerie D. Rubio (PAL)'; 'Confirmed by SAP AIS MM Purchasing Dev Support and reproduced by Mahender in QS4-160 (PO 5000001993 created only after the rounding value was removed)'. Source header: 'Client : Philippine Airlines (PAL) Ref : INC01192'.
business_requirement: After 'send prices' from Ariba Sourcing, no purchase order was generated in S/4 for materials that carry a rounding value (example EA02, plant 2PHQ, rounding value 120 GAL). PAL keeps the rounding value for MRP requisition sizing, so the PO must be created with the awarded quantity without removing it.
technical_challenge: Ariba posts through BAPI_PO_CREATE1, which rounds each item to MARC-BSTRF; the rounded quantity exceeds the open requisition quantity and the PO is rejected. The flag NO_ROUNDING has to be set only on the BAPI path, leaving ME21N and the MRP run unchanged. Finding the right exit was error-prone: ME_BAPI_PO_CUST is delivered with interface IF_EX_ME_BAPI_PO_CREATE_02, and SE19 'Copy Sample' leaves SAP demo logic live in all nine methods.
ai_contribution: The assistant wrote the BAdI implementation class following SAP's pointer (NO_ROUNDING = X in POITEM / POITEMX): the current file is the whole class, 122 lines, with INBOUND looping over the items and the eight other methods empty. Along the way it produced a PROCESS_ITEM fallback on ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST (retired, kept in git only), removed the caller gate and the POITEMX append after Arnav's decision, replaced the sample logic left by 'Copy Sample', and corrected the interface name in the header. NOTES.md carries the SE19 activation walk-through, a four-step test plan including regression, and the scope gotchas.
manual_intervention: Arnav created the implementation in SE19 on 17/09/26 via 'Copy Sample'; first opened the wrong BAdI in SE18 and then confirmed that INBOUND exists and its signature on the PAL system (CH_ITEM / CH_ITEMX, both changing); decided that the flag applies to every BAPI caller, dropping the TVARVC gate. The functional consultant reproduced the problem in QS4-160 and obtained SAP's confirmation. Paste, SE19 activation and all tests are manual.
